name: mage against a crowd
why: keep spells landing when several melee creatures come at once: hit them together while they bunch up, then finish the weakest

open.says: Attack from range with strong single-target spells while the creatures are still coming.

transitions.when: Three or more creatures are bunched up close together near the mage.

blast.says: Stand and cast area spells at the bunch: every creature there takes damage from each cast.

transitions.when: Only one or two creatures are left close, or most of them are badly hurt.
transitions.unless: Three or more fairly healthy creatures are still bunched up together.

transitions.when: Mana is nearly gone and several creatures are still fighting.

finish.says: Finish the creature with the least health left with quick single-target spells.

transitions.when: Three or more creatures are bunched up close together again.
Mana is nearly gone and creatures are still fighting.

out.says: Get away from the fight and recover mana at a distance.

transitions.when: Mana is back above half and nothing is close.
